# [Jane Doe]{.name ref="#jane"} and [Old Tam]{.name} {#cast}

| Who | Where |
| --- | --- |
| [Jane]{.name ref="#jane"} | [[place-harbor\|the harbor]]{.name} |
| [Old Tam]{.name} | the nets |

[Jane Doe]{.name ref="#jane"} keeps the ferry to [[place-harbor|the harbor]]{.name}. [Jane]{.name ref="#jane"} rows it alone, and the river folk call her [Miss Gorgeous]{.name ref="#jane"}.

[Old Tam]{.name} mends the nets on the quay, and [old tam]{.name} sells them at [[place-harbor|the harbor]]{.name} when [Jane]{.name ref="#jane"} brings the ferry in.
